Get a Free Valuation today... 100% focused on Excess Inventory Management CCL provides OEM and EMS companies with a one-stop solution for their excess component inventory. Despite various industry improvements, excess inventory will always be an issue that all OEM and EMS providers face. When these challenges arise, choosing an established inventory management specialist to support them is essential. We specialise in buying excess, surplus or overstocked new and unused passive and active electronic components. These include Semiconductors , ICs , Diodes , Transistors , Capacitors , Memory and Microprocessors . Using bespoke software, we match your excess to our database of BOMs and proactively market it to our extensive network of OEMs, CEMs, and distributors worldwide to ensure you receive the highest return.
